environment.runtime: x64 Windows Server Core LTSC 2022 console in a Hyper-V-isolated container
environment.input: Win32 console key events for Code and Ctrl+F1 profile switching
environment.fixtures: LLVM MC 23.1.6 generated raw streams, sixteen-byte NOP-padded extension slots, and a generated PE32+ image

paired_checks.candidate: GNU-target x64 build in the same Windows console
paired_checks.comparison: The opcode bytes, mnemonic and operand cells, and foreground and background on nonblank instruction cells matched in the three raw streams up to the first encoding rejected by HIEW. The separate 60900F fixture matched on the initial #UD(64) row.

truncated_input: On the raw 60900F fixture in 64-bit mode, the final lone 0F is displayed as sldt [rax]. The adapter reports Truncated and advances one byte.
limits: The samples cover individual encodings from established and newer extensions. TUI data-reference arrows and original rejection lengths for valid newer instructions remain open.
